A three-drug regimen was reported for 30 patients; 29 had a TDF/TAF and FTC/3TC backbone with the third drug as follows: 10 (29.4%) bictegravir, 9 (26.5%) boosted darunavir, 5 (14.7%) dolutegravir (DTG) and 5 (14.7%) raltegravir.
